title.narrative: SUSTAIN - Sustainable forest conservation in southeastern Liberia

description.narrative:
The overall objective (impact) of the proposed action is to enhance the conservation and protection status of biodiversity, as well as the participation, living conditions and resilience of rural populations (particularly women and youth) living around protected areas and community forests in Southeast Liberia. The specific objectives (outcomes) leading to the overall objective are the following:

Outcome 1: Enhance governance and management efficiency of proposed and established protected areas;

Outcome 2: Improve monitoring and protection of proposed and established protected areas and community forests in Southeast Liberia;

Outcome 3: Improve living conditions of people (especially women and youth) living near proposed and established protected areas and community forests in Southeast Liberia.
